record_id.description: Content-addressed dataset record ID; not a verified person ID. SHA-256 of the nine normalized source-content fields.

masked_id.description: Source identifier, preserving three digits, six literal x characters and four digits. Not unique; never reconstruct hidden digits.

full_name_th.description: Thai name as transcribed, with conservative Unicode NFC and whitespace normalization. No identity matching.

score_adjustment_reported.description: Integer adjustment reported by the source; not an independently verified examination result.

agency_name_th.description: Agency label transcribed from the source. Abbreviations are preserved.

source_status_text.description: Verbatim-normalized first status column (source claim, not project verification).

district_name_th.description: District label as reported in the source. Scope by province_id.

province_name_th.description: Province label as reported in the document and row.

source_location_basis_text.description: Source author's stated basis for location/agency confirmation. Not independently checked here.

source_verification_status_text.description: Second status column as reported by the source. Does not verify allegations or establish wrongdoing.

province_id.description: Hash of the source province label; not an official administrative code.

district_id.description: Hash of the ordered province and district labels; not an official administrative code.

agency_location_id.description: Hash of province, district and agency labels; a source-label group, not a verified organization ID.
